title: Sir 1st Lord Blachford Frederic Rogers
dates: (1811-1889)
---

landowner

He succeeded his father as 8th baronet in 1851 and was created (1871) 1st Lord Blachford; he married (1847) Georgiana Mary Colvile (d. 13 July 1900), they had no children and lived at Blachford Park, near Cornwood [ODNB]
